output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
import json

def normalize_expense_response(raw_response):
    normalized = {
        "merchant_name": "",
        "total_amount": None,
        "currency": "",
        "invoice_date": "",
        "items": []
    }

    document = raw_response.document
    pages = document.pages

    for page in pages:
        for block in page.blocks:
            text = block.text.content

            # Extract merchant name
            if "merchant" in text.lower():
                normalized["merchant_name"] = text.strip()

            # Extract total amount and currency
            if "total" in text.lower():
                parts = text.split("$")
                if len(parts) > 1:
                    normalized["total_amount"] = float(parts[1].strip())
                    normalized["currency"] = "USD"

            # Extract invoice date
            if "date" in text.lower():
                normalized["invoice_date"] = text.strip()

            # Extract items
            if "item" in text.lower() or "description" in text.lower():
                item = {
                    "description": "",
                    "quantity": 0,
                    "unit_price": None,
                    "total_price": None
                }

                # Parse item description
                description_parts = text.split(":")
                if len(description_parts) > 1:
                    item["description"] = description_parts[0].strip()

                # Parse quantity, unit price, and total price
                numeric_parts = [part.strip() for part in description_parts[1:] if part.strip().replace(".", "", 1).isdigit()]
                if len(numeric_parts) >= 2:
                    item["quantity"] = int(numeric_parts[0])
                    item["unit_price"] = float(numeric_parts[1])
                    item["total_price"] = float(numeric_parts[2])

                normalized["items"].append(item)

    return json.dumps(normalized, indent=2)

def process_expense_document(document_path):
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    name = f"projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/processors/PROCESSOR_ID"
    with open(document_path, "rb") as file:
        input_config = documentai.InputConfig(content=documentai.InputConfig.Content(file=file))

    response = client.process_document(name=name, input_config=input_config)
    return normalize_expense_response(response)

# Example usage
document_path = "path/to/invoice.pdf"
normalized_expense = process_expense_document(document_path)
print(normalized_expense)
```
